0022600167.text: The Houston Rockets host the Boston Celtics in the Rockets' eighth game of the season. Houston is 6-1 overall, 3-0 at home, and 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, while Boston is 4-1 with four straight wins and sits 3rd in the East after going 4-0 at home and 0-1 on the road. For Houston, Steven Adams is out with a calf strain, and Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Reed Sheppard (back) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; for Boston, Devin Carter is out with an illness and Mitchell Robinson is out for rest. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the most recent meeting came on February 4, 2026 in Houston, when the Celtics won 114-93.
